body:
Recently, I extracted pure DMT from 250g of Mimosa Hostilis root bark powder. However, Ive never tried DMT before, and this was my first extraction. I think I should smoke a bit to test whether I extracted the DMT correctly.
Prior to this, Ive taken several psychedelic substances, including shrooms, LSD (and some analogs like 1V-LSD), 2C-B-FLY, 4-HO-MET (one of my favorites), 4-HO-MIPT, and MDMA.
I was with a friend of mine in my house at the night, be he did not wanted to test it
After extracting the DMT, I discovered that the method of smoking it is quite specific. Initially, I considered using the sandwich method, but I had some e-liquid with a 70/30 VG/PG ratio and decided to infuse a lower dose than recommended in online forums (I mixed about 200mg of DMT into 1ml of liquid) and put a bit of the resulting mixture in my sub-ohm vaporizer.
I was a bit nervous and started testing the wattage from low to high, beginning at 5W. I started noticing something at around 12W. I was taking big pulls and holding the vapor as long as I could.
I started noticing something at around 12W. I was taking big pulls and holding the vapor as long as I could.
It wasnt until my fourth try that the DMT hit me, although I think the concentration was very low. The first thing I noticed was a pressure in my head and a ringing in my ears (which I hadnt experienced with any of the other drugs Ive taken before).
With my eyes open, I could see strange patterns, like darker shapes on the walls of my room. I took another big pull with my eyes closed, now that I had tested the potency. I started to experience a kind of hallucination with my eyes closed. It was very well-defined but not like the bright, geometric colors in simulation videos. Instead, I saw two rolls of cloth (blue with golden squares and symbols), spinning and moving in what seemed like a nonsensical room.
I was lying in bed, but I felt the position of my body in a strange, angled way. The hallucination slowly disintegrated into nothing, and I opened my eyes. I took another big pull and noticed from the flavor that the e-liquid was running out. I held the vapor as long as I could, with my eyes open and the light on. The wall began to form into an ominous, undefined shape, but that didnt last long.
Overall, this drug seems to be very unique compared to other tryptamines. For instance, I didnt experience any drifting at all. Next time, Ill take a heavier dose with the proper equipment. I think the e-mesh is one of the best methods Ive seen online, because I feel this drug should be taken in a moderate to strong dosage and the fewer hits to achieve the dosage the better.
